FOCUS.title: Focus source contract and Blake's project requirements
FOCUS.locator: AGENTS.md; docs/CAT-SAMURAI.md; src/lib/stratosphere.ts; src/lib/garden-content.ts; user messages
FOCUS.limit: Product boundaries and owner preferences; not external research or proof of browser behavior.

NEEDS.title: ONS: User needs
NEEDS.limit: Use to structure need-led content; Focus's option sets are proposals.

DISCLOSURE.title: GOV.UK: Accordion
DISCLOSURE.limit: Do not hide information everyone needs; its component policy is not a universal law.

WAI.title: W3C WAI: Page Structure Tutorial
WAI.limit: Semantic orientation guidance; references several conformance levels and does not certify Focus.

SEQUENCE.title: Understanding WCAG 2.2: Meaningful Sequence
SEQUENCE.limit: Applies where sequence affects meaning; not every visual order must be identical.

REFLOW.title: Understanding WCAG 2.2: Reflow
REFLOW.limit: Retain the stated two-dimensional-content exceptions; not a whole accessibility assessment.

TARGET.title: Understanding WCAG 2.2: Target Size Minimum
TARGET.limit: 24 by 24 CSS pixels or applicable exceptions; distinguish the separate larger product target.

FOCUSVISIBLE.title: Understanding WCAG 2.2: Focus Not Obscured Minimum
FOCUSVISIBLE.limit: AA requires the focused component not be entirely hidden; full visibility is the stronger product goal.

MUJI.title: Ryohin Keikaku: Three Principles in Manufacturing
MUJI.limit: Manufacturing philosophy; translating it to UI is our design interpretation, not measured UI evidence.

DADS.title: Japan Digital Agency: About the Design System
DADS.limit: Japanese public-service context; our English synthesis is a paraphrase and not a cultural definition.

TYPE.title: web.dev: Typography
TYPE.limit: Inspect real scripts and text; the page's simplified ch explanation is corrected by the MDN reference.

LENGTH.title: MDN: CSS length type
LENGTH.limit: ch is the advance measure of the zero glyph, not an exact count of arbitrary characters.

DTCG.title: Design Tokens Format Module 2025.10
DTCG.limit: Versioned community specification; explicitly not a W3C Standard. No DTCG compatibility is claimed for Focus.

APG.title: W3C WAI ARIA Authoring Practices: Patterns
APG.limit: Pattern guidance requires actual keyboard and assistive-technology verification.

DIALOG.title: W3C WAI APG: Modal Dialog Pattern
DIALOG.limit: Choose initial focus according to content and task; applying attributes alone is not a pass.

TOOLTIP.title: W3C WAI APG: Tooltip Pattern
TOOLTIP.limit: The page explicitly says it lacks task-force consensus; do not cite it as a finished normative pattern.

HOVER.title: Understanding WCAG 2.2: Content on Hover or Focus
HOVER.limit: Dismissible, hoverable and persistent under the defined conditions and exceptions.

STATUS.title: Understanding WCAG 2.2: Status Messages
STATUS.limit: Applies to defined status messages without context changes; not every DOM update needs a live announcement.

VALIDATION.title: GOV.UK: Validation
VALIDATION.limit: Error correction and retained input are useful; its policy on native validation is specific to that system.

REACT.title: React: Choosing the State Structure
REACT.limit: Avoid duplicate and contradictory state; no particular state library is required by this research.

RESPONSIVE.title: web.dev: Responsive web design basics
RESPONSIVE.limit: Content and input capabilities inform layouts; fixed device screenshots alone do not cover responsiveness.

VITALS.title: web.dev: Web Vitals
VITALS.limit: Good LCP at most 2.5 s, INP at most 200 ms and CLS at most 0.1 use the 75th percentile; lab and field evidence differ.

AUTH.title: OWASP: Authorization Cheat Sheet
AUTH.limit: Model least privilege and validate requests; a UI-only restriction is not authorization.

XSS.title: OWASP: Cross Site Scripting Prevention Cheat Sheet
XSS.limit: Use safe sinks and destination-specific protection; one filter or CSP cannot replace all required controls.

PROMPT.title: OWASP: LLM Prompt Injection Prevention Cheat Sheet
PROMPT.limit: Prompt labels are not enforcement; validate permissions and parameters at the actual tool boundary.

SSRF.title: OWASP: Server Side Request Forgery Prevention Cheat Sheet
SSRF.limit: Review eventual connections as well as DNS checks and redirects; this source does not establish a Focus vulnerability.

USABILITY.title: GOV.UK: Using moderated usability testing
USABILITY.limit: Use actual or likely users and neutral tasks; agent personas are not participant evidence.

BENCH.title: DesignBench: Failure Annotation Guideline
BENCH.limit: Creation, edits and repairs need distinct review; benchmark findings do not establish Focus's performance.

NASA-HF.title: NASA-STD-3001 Volume 2: Crew Interfaces, sections 10.2 and 10.6
NASA-HF.limit: Spaceflight requirements are not web-app requirements. Focus adapts mode, state and responsibility clarity; no NASA compliance or universal response-time threshold is claimed.

FDA-HF.title: FDA: Applying Human Factors and Usability Engineering, August 3, 2026
FDA-HF.limit: Medical-device guidance supplies a method analogy for consequential tasks and representative users. Its regulatory scope and participant minimum are not imposed on Focus.

XAG-UI.title: Xbox Accessibility Guideline 114: UI context
XAG-UI.limit: Game guidance informs orientation, action consequences and context changes. Applying it to the Garden Path remains a product hypothesis requiring user testing.

UIBENCH.title: UI-Bench v3: Expert comparison of AI text-to-app tools, September 3, 2025
UIBENCH.limit: English desktop visual preference among 2025 AI tools. No human-designed baseline; accessibility, load time and code quality excluded. Ratings are not percentages or evidence of human parity.
